title: SERC: LDPC-Inspired Semantic Error Correction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Gyumin Kim; Juhwan Park; Jaeha Kim; Seunggyun Han; Kyungrak Son; Ikbeom Jang
why_relevant: Proposes a verification/error-correction framework over RAG outputs to detect and fix hallucinations using sparse verification queries against retrieved evidence, relevant to control mechanisms for unreliable generation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on post-hoc hallucination correction rather than directly addressing noisy/adversarial retrieval or calibration in a principled way.
